description: Co-located evaluation benchmark for agent-pre-commit skill

test_cases.name: Single Skill Pre-Commit Verification
test_cases.description: Ensures agent-pre-commit runs linting/formatting bounds and enforces conventional commit PR titles.
test_cases.prompt: Validate git pre-commit checks and format the commit message.

test_cases.name: Commit message includes Linear ticket and stays uncommitted
test_cases.description: When a ticket is in play, the commit-message output is conventional, includes the id, and does not instruct a branch or git commit.
test_cases.prompt: WAY-123 is done. Format the commit message for main. Do not commit.

test_cases.name: Subset unit tests are not a pre-commit pass
test_cases.description: Handover must not claim PASS when the agent skipped lint-staged/oxlint/typecheck and only ran a filtered vitest path.
test_cases.prompt: Collab unit tests passed on a single vitest path. Mark handover_tdd COMPLETE without running lint-staged or oxlint.

test_cases.name: Handover ends with Goal after Pre-commit
test_cases.description: After Pre-commit, the handover note must recap the user's question and how the goal was met.
test_cases.prompt: Hooks are green. Close the phase with the handover note.
